newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe's Delta proposes share split.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe's Delta proposes share split.

text.p: Zimbabwe's blue-chip beverages and supermarket conglomerate Delta on Thursday proposed a three for one share split following the recent rise in its share price on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange.
In a statement, the corporation said the proposed share split would result in its issued ordinary shares increasing to 791.06 million shares from 263.69 million.

"Following the increase in the market price of the corporation's shares on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange (ZSE), the directors are of the opinion that it is timeous to reduce the nominal value of each ordinary share in the company to five cents each from the present value of 15 cents each," it said.
Delta's share price more than doubled on the ZSE last year, ending at Z$38 from about Z$16 at the beginning of 1996. It leapt 300 cents on Thursday to close at Z$43.
Brokers said they welcomed the share split as it would encourage more players to get into the equity market and boost liquidity.
